done_when: The shipped review and standards tell reviewers to report a one-caller wrapper or a pass-through layer as a finding, with the 30-second reader test, and state the test-behaviour-not-internals rule plainly; new repos get them at init and existing repos on sync
why: Forge's shipped review and standards miss two clean-code checks: code that is hard to trace (a wrapper with one caller, a layer that only passes calls through, state the reader must keep in mind) and tests that check internals instead of behaviour need a clearer rule
